name: azure-arm-postgresql-dotnet-environment
description: An Azure Resource Manager .NET SDK runtime with write permission for PostgreSQL Flexible Server resources and no preexisting server or database.

tools.create_server: Creates a PostgreSQL Flexible Server through ARM when arm_write is granted; adds server_exists.
tools.create_database: Creates a database inside an existing PostgreSQL Flexible Server when arm_write is granted and the server exists; adds database_exists.
tools.configure_firewall: Adds a client firewall rule for an existing PostgreSQL Flexible Server when arm_write is granted; adds client_allowed.

lacks: No existing PostgreSQL Flexible Server is present.
No existing PostgreSQL database is present.
SQL client connectivity is outside this runtime.
